description: A chart-race of sky-high startup valuations that crashed to earth — WeWork, Theranos, FTX, Quibi and Juicero. Watch peaks, blowups and total collapses from 2007–2026.
youtube_description:
Unicorn Implosions — the rise and catastrophic falls of some of Silicon Valley’s most talked-about startups. This video races through 2007–2026 showing real peak valuations and the moments everything went wrong: Theranos peaked at ~$9B (2014) before scandal; WeWork ballooned to ~$47B (Jan 2019) and crashed into a restructuring; FTX rose to ~$32B (Nov 2021) and filed for bankruptcy in Nov 2022; Quibi raised ~$1.75B and folded in Oct 2020; Juicero raised ~ $120M (peak ≈$0.12B) and shuttered in 2017.

What you’ll see: dramatic climbs, headline-making peaks and instant wipeouts — all based on public valuations, funding rounds and official filings. Perfect for a high-contrast chart race edit.

Like the vid? Smash subscribe, turn on notifications, and drop a comment on which collapse surprised you the most. Download the CSV for editing (link in pinned comment).
